0022600033.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-7, 15th in the West, 5.5 games back in the Pacific) host the San Antonio Spurs (6-2, winners of six straight, 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back) in the Kings' 9th game of the 2026-27 season and the Emirates NBA Cup West Group C. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Daeqwon Plowden is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The Kings trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 130-103 loss in San Antonio, and they lost all three meetings in 2025-26.
